<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The candidate summary does not state or provide dates to calculate total years of backend engineering experience. 

Could you please provide the total number of years of backend engineering experience the candidate has?

**The cost of not supplying this figure:**
The job posting explicitly requires **8 years of backend engineering experience**. Without stating this metric, applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruiters will not be able to verify that the candidate meets the baseline qualification. This typically results in automatic disqualification or the application being filtered out before reaching a hiring manager. 

*(Once you provide the number of years, I can finalize the rewritten summary to explicitly highlight how they meet or exceed this requirement.)*
